picks.headline: Threat actor Storm-3168 deploys agentic AI for automated cloud attacks
picks.why: Demonstrates real-world active threat actors deploying autonomous AI agents to automate cloud reconnaissance and asset destruction.
picks.title: Storm-3168: Agentic-driven cloud attacks using compromised service principals

picks.headline: Meta's Muse provisions dedicated, persistent Linux VMs for personal AI agents
picks.why: Marks a major architectural shift by moving agent execution into isolated, persistent cloud virtual machines.
picks.title: Quoting John Gruber

picks.headline: Denial-of-Wallet attacks exploit retained tool outputs to amplify LLM costs 14,000x
picks.why: Exposes a vulnerability in tool-calling agents where accumulated state can be exploited to cause massive financial exhaustion.
picks.title: Persistent Billable State: Denial-of-Wallet Attacks and Defenses in Tool-Calling LLM Agents

picks.headline: AWS and Qumulo enable multi-region model training without data replication
picks.why: Solves a major scaling bottleneck by allowing distributed GPU clusters in different regions to train directly without duplicating datasets.
picks.title: Multi-Region training with Amazon SageMaker HyperPod and Qumulo

picks.headline: Alternate tokenization choices bypass model unlearning and knowledge editing guards
picks.why: Shows that knowledge unlearning and safety editing can be systematically bypassed simply by altering how input text is tokenized.
picks.title: The Tokens Remember: When Tokenization Bypasses Knowledge Editing and Unlearning

papers.headline: Transformers demonstrate linear superposition allowing dual-thought decoding from single layers
papers.why: Demonstrates that LLMs superpose independent next-token distributions in linear space, enabling disentangled parallel decoding.
papers.title: Your Transformer Can Hold Two Thoughts at Once: Evidence of Linear Superposition in LLMs

papers.headline: Rufus-Air delivers fully open post-training recipe for 106B MoE models
papers.why: Offers a completely transparent post-training methodology for large MoE models without needing proprietary teacher models or human annotation.
papers.title: Rufus-Air: An Open LLM Post-Training Recipe

papers.headline: SpecHarness replaces LLM agent execution authority with formal specification validation
papers.why: Decouples decision generation from execution authority to prevent autonomous agents from overstepping intended task boundaries.
papers.title: Who Holds the Pen? Let Specifications, Not Agents, Sign Off
